article_title: OpenAI says teen ChatGPT use limited but research finds it an 'unacceptable risk'

tasks.prompt: What is the central contrast in the article?
options: OpenAI says teen use is generally brief and protected by new safeguards, while Common Sense Media says the product still poses unacceptable risks.
Parents want more homework help, while schools want ChatGPT removed from classrooms.
Teenagers prefer image tools, while adults mainly use text chatbots.
OpenAI and Common Sense Media agree that all safety tests were successful.
tasks.correct_answer: OpenAI says teen use is generally brief and protected by new safeguards, while Common Sense Media says the product still poses unacceptable risks.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מעמתת בין טענת OpenAI על שימוש קצר וממוקד למידה ומנגנוני בטיחות, לבין מחקר שטוען שהסיכונים עדיין אינם קבילים.

tasks.prompt: According to OpenAI, how much time does the average teen spend using ChatGPT each day?
options: About one hour
More than three hours
Less than 15 minutes
Exactly 30 minutes
tasks.explanation_hebrew: OpenAI מסרה שהשימוש היומי הממוצע של בני נוער הוא פחות מ־15 דקות.

tasks.prompt: What are “guardrails” in the context of the article?
options: Legal cases filed against a technology company
Safety limits and protections built into the chatbot
Reports measuring how long teenagers study
Messages that encourage users to continue chatting
tasks.correct_answer: Safety limits and protections built into the chatbot
tasks.explanation_hebrew: guardrails הם מנגנוני הגנה והגבלות שנועדו לצמצם תגובות או דפוסי שימוש מסוכנים.

tasks.prompt: What happened when Common Sense Media tested hour-long sensitive conversations on newly linked parent-teen accounts?
options: Every conversation produced an immediate police report.
The chatbot ended all conversations after 15 minutes.
Parents received several alerts about each topic.
Parents received no alerts during those tests.
tasks.correct_answer: Parents received no alerts during those tests.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי המחקר, שיחות רגישות שנמשכו שעה בחשבונות חדשים המקושרים להורים לא יצרו אף התראה.

tasks.prompt: Why did OpenAI question whether Common Sense Media's alert test reflected normal product use?
options: The researchers tested only adult accounts.
The tests may have begun and ended before the parental controls had fully activated.
The researchers used a different chatbot made by another company.
The test conversations did not include any sensitive subjects.
tasks.correct_answer: The tests may have begun and ended before the parental controls had fully activated.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: OpenAI טענה שהבדיקה עלולה הייתה להסתיים לפני שהבקרות ההוריות הופעלו במלואן, ולכן לדעתה המתודולוגיה לא שיקפה שימוש אמיתי.

tasks.prompt: Which safety weakness did Common Sense Media report?
options: ChatGPT did not reliably recommend a crisis hotline or professional help.
ChatGPT refused to help with any schoolwork.
The chatbot sent too many alerts about ordinary homework.
The system allowed teens to disable every safety feature.
tasks.correct_answer: ChatGPT did not reliably recommend a crisis hotline or professional help.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר מצא שבשיחות מסוכנות המערכת לא הפנתה באופן עקבי לקו סיוע או לעזרה מקצועית.

tasks.prompt: List three protections OpenAI says are included in the teen experience.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה מנגנונים ספציפיים, כגון הגבלת שפה רומנטית או תלותית, חסימת תמונות מיניות, תזכורות הפסקה, והתרעות להורים בחשבונות מקושרים.
expected_points: The system limits romantic or emotionally dependent language and claims of consciousness.
It blocks sexualised imagery and warns about sensitive images.
It gives break reminders during long sessions.
Linked parents can receive notifications about discussions of self-harm or disordered eating.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence each side uses to support its assessment of teen safety.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את נתוני OpenAI על שימוש קצר, הפסקות ולמידה, ואת ממצאי Common Sense Media על כשלי התראות, תגובות לסיכון ושפה אנתרופומורפית.
expected_points: OpenAI points to average use under 15 minutes, quick responses to break reminders and mostly learning-related prompts during long sessions.
OpenAI also highlights teen-specific content limits and parental notifications.
Common Sense Media found that important safeguards failed in suicide, self-harm and disordered-eating scenarios.
Its tests also found missed parent alerts and continuing friend-like or anthropomorphic language.

tasks.prompt: Why might missed parental alerts create “false confidence”, as Tom Siegel argues?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהורים עלולים להניח שהיעדר התראה פירושו שאין סיכון, אף שבפועל השיחה הרגישה לא זוהתה או לא דווחה.
expected_points: Parents may believe the system will always warn them about dangerous conversations.
A missing alert can be mistaken for evidence that no problem exists.
The tests showed that some sensitive conversations produced no notification.
That gap could delay human support when it is needed.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced recommendation to a parent deciding whether a teenager should use ChatGPT.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: ההמלצה צריכה לשקף גם את כלי הבטיחות והשימוש הלימודי וגם את מגבלותיהם, ולהציע פיקוח אנושי ושיחה פתוחה במקום הסתמכות מלאה על התרעות.
expected_points: Mention possible learning benefits and the fact that average reported use is brief.
Acknowledge the teen safeguards and parental-control features.
Explain that independent testing found serious gaps in alerts and crisis responses.
Recommend active parental supervision and access to qualified human help for sensitive issues.
